invariant_audit.nonzero_and_zero_cases: m=0 is excluded only on psi!=0 support; n=0 is excluded by the transposed betaCarrier and U>=1. v=0 and v=a are excluded before divisor membership. Empty rows and psi=0 rows are explicitly handled. hd gives Q1>=1; p>=Q1>=1 in geometry, so no division-by-zero substitution is used.

invariant_audit.kappa_scope: No new kappa cap or sign condition is introduced. The only hypotheses are unchanged MediumAdmissible and sigma>0. Thus the finite step covers the full original kappa range and indeed does not use its numerical bound.
invariant_audit.roughness_and_transposition: Original roughness and all medium gates remain inside hd. No stronger roughness, SW, or transposed MediumAdmissible is assumed. Geometry uses the generic cutoff support theorem at original V.
invariant_audit.ordered_pair_accounting: Cauchy bounds the original full square, including its diagonal and both ordered off-diagonal terms. After Cauchy, each remaining (p,m,n) label is injected separately. Ordered (m,n) factorizations and different p values are paid independently.
invariant_audit.support_endpoint: m<=3V is inferred from true psi!=0 support, not from m<=ceil(3V). Consequently the 6*scale endpoint is justified before widening the sum.
invariant_audit.no_target_premise: No R bound, folded bound, analytic shifted moment, M2, Shiu, or spectral theorem appears among the proof hypotheses. The generic F lemma assumes only pointwise nonnegativity.
invariant_audit.outside_factor: Eout uses original d.beta and d.gamma1 and occurs once on each side of the final consumer. Its separately available upper bound is read but is not applied or duplicated here.
